en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a landscaped park with tree‑lined paths and the stone remains of an old structure featuring large arches and walls. In the foreground a woman and a child walk along a curved path. The reverse side includes printed multilingual captions identifying the location as the Tettye ruins in Pécs, Hungary, along with handwritten Hungarian text, an address, and a Hungarian postage stamp.
